description.value: A private resort on the peaceful shores of Pinantan Lake, 20 minutes from Kamloops, with cabin rentals and full-service RV sites; no tent camping is listed, cell service drops before arrival, and the gate locks at 8 pm.

address.value: 2488 Harper Ranch Road, Pinantan Lake, BC V0E 3E1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and provides strong primary evidence. The resort is a full-service RV park and cabin rental property on Pinantan Lake, ~20 minutes from Kamloops. No tent or hiker/biker sites are mentioned anywhere on the site; OSM tags the property as 'caravan_site', consistent with the RV-park focus. Reservations are confirmed via online booking references; 30-amp power at RV sites is noted but not confirmed as available to non-RV guests. Phone and address on the website match OSM-derived values.
concerns: OSM tag is 'caravan_site' (RV park) and the website describes only cabin rentals and full-service RV hookup sites — no tent camping or walk-in/cyclist sites are mentioned anywhere.
Phone number (250) 573-3534 appears on the website but was absent from OSM tags; contact_confirmed.phone set to null as OSM had no value to cross-check.
Website FAQ notes cell service drops approximately 15 minutes before arrival, indicating very limited connectivity at the property.
Seasonal operation (May 1 to mid-October, limited winter availability by request) — not a year-round facility.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The property is a legitimate and operating lakeside resort, but it is exclusively an RV park and cabin rental operation with no mention of tent sites or hiker/biker accommodation; suitability for touring cyclists who need a campsite cannot be confirmed from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.notes: If the resort does offer tent sites or walk-in camping for cyclists, this would be worth confirming via direct contact before including in the directory.

wow_evidence: exclusively an RV park and cabin rental operation with no mention of tent sites
